resources.string: Git can\'t stage, commit, or pull while index.lock exists. It is usually left behind when an operation is interrupted, for example when Android stops the app.
Only do this if no other Git app is using this folder right now. Your files and commits are not changed.
The lock changed or was just created, so another Git app may be using this repository. Close other Git apps, wait a few seconds, then try again.
The Git index is locked. If nothing else is using this repository, tap Remove lock on the Git screen.
Up to date. No new commits on the remote.
